title: On August 20, 2025, the head of the international department of the Bashkir State Pedagogical University named after M. Akmulla visited BSU named after K. Karasaev

blocks.text: The guest was received by the rector of BSU Dyldaev M.M. The meeting was also attended by the dean of the faculty of Russian philology Niyazalieva A.A., the dean of the faculty of pedagogical education Muratalieva M.A., the director of the department of international cooperation Kanatbekov E.K., as well as the chief specialist-coordinator for international educational programs Rai kyzy Rakhat.

During the negotiations, the parties discussed prospects for developing cooperation between universities, strengthening academic ties, implementing academic mobility programs and student and faculty exchanges, as well as opportunities for joint implementation of international educational projects and programs.

It was separately noted that already in the current semester, 6 BSU students, as well as one professor as a guest lecturer, will be sent to the Bashkir State Pedagogical University under the academic mobility program, which will become a new stage in the practical implementation of the agreements reached.

The visit became an important step in expanding partnership relations and opens up new prospects for long-term and productive cooperation between BSU named after K. Karasaev and BSPU named after M. Akmulla.
